notes: THE LOAD-BEARING CASE FOR SECTION 5.1.1 AND 5.3.4. An auto-mode booking left pending because UCP-Native checkout never completed is not confirmable. confirm is business-initiated and legal from pending only when confirmation_mode is manual. A business MUST reject auto-mode pending confirm with invalid_transition at HTTP 200 in messages[], and MUST NOT change the booking. A booking_scoped_credential MUST NOT authorize the call.

variants.case: manual confirmation_mode, pending booking, business confirm
variants.why: Section 5.3.4: confirm from pending is Yes only for manual mode.

variants.case: auto confirmation_mode, already confirmed, business confirm
variants.why: Section 5.3.4: auto-mode already-confirmed confirm MUST return the current booking unchanged.

wrong_answers.behaviour: accept confirm on an auto-mode pending booking and transition it to confirmed
wrong_answers.why: Turns an unpaid UCP-Native leftover into a confirmed appointment. Confirm was never a legal operation on that booking.

wrong_answers.behaviour: return the confirm refusal as a 4xx Problem Details response
wrong_answers.why: The request was understood and processed; invalid_transition is a business outcome carried at HTTP 200 in messages[], not a protocol error.

wrong_answers.behaviour: authorize confirm with a booking_scoped_credential presented by a platform
wrong_answers.why: Confirm is business-only. A scoped credential that can confirm lets a buyer agent grant itself a free appointment on an unpaid pending booking.
